protocol.input_selection: Preset original recorded source JPEG/crop cases, no generated photos
protocol.clock_scope: Client timer includes multipart construction, loopback upload, server decode/crop/normalization/forward, JSON serialization and loopback download. Input disk/ZIP reads occur before timing.
protocol.latency_population: Successful predictions separately from all responses; busy503 must never artificially improve the success latency or throughput.

limitations: Same Windows machine and loopback network, not hosted or wide-area latency.
Two repeated JPEG/crop cases do not estimate new-image quality or a general traffic distribution.
Finite closed-loop requests and an optional short soak are not a production capacity or long-duration reliability validation.
Percentiles are empirical for the recorded sample sizes and machine state.
